svg.title: KIWI - Technical Approach
svg.desc: Hackathon technical architecture slide: React renderer and Tauri Rust host desktop client, the ten-crate Rust workspace, local-first SQLite storage, and the Node/TypeScript org control plane on docker compose.
svg.text: client-app — Tauri 2 desktop (WebView shell, native Rust core)
Tokio async · lock gate · consent boundary
keyring OS credential store · rfd dialogs
counts and ids only, never payloads
Rust workspace — 10 cargo crates (edition 2024, unsafe_code = forbid)
Local-first storage — SQLite on the host, Postgres for the org plane
CI: cargo test/clippy/fmt · vitest · CDP smoke · gitleaks · docker compose
KIWI — Email that proves its security
